definitions.explanation: dishes served alongside rice in a Japanese meal; anything eaten with rice as the main accompaniment

examples.japanese: おかず⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}り→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{過|す}ぎた→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
examples.english: I made too many side dishes.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧おかず⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: This side dish goes really well with rice.

notes:
WRITING:
Can be written as {御菜|おかず} or {御数|おかず}, but hiragana is most common.

JAPANESE MEAL STRUCTURE:
A traditional Japanese meal consists of:
- ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧ (rice) - the main staple
- ⟦{汁|しる}{物|もの}→汁物：06231_shirumono⟧ (soup, e.g., ⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧)
- おかず (side dishes) - the accompaniments

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧おかず (side dish for rice)
- おかず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to serve as a side dish)
- ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧おかず (today's side dish)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{惣菜|そうざい}→惣菜：05827_souzai⟧ (prepared dishes, deli food)
- ⟦{副菜|ふくさい}→副菜：04993_fukusai⟧ (side dish - formal)
- ⟦{主菜|しゅさい}→主菜：04995_shusai⟧ (main dish)
